# Find Your Fit: Exploring the Stages of a New Tri Pointe Home


Tri Pointe Homes


•


November 5, 2026


Share this article


When you’re looking for a new home, it’s natural to start with the spaces you’ll use every day: a kitchen with room to gather, a quiet spot to work or a covered patio for winding down. Along with finding a floorplan you love, you’ll want to consider your ideal move-in timeline and how involved you’d like to be in choosing design details.


As you browse[Available Homes](https://www.tripointehomes.com/find-your-home?type=move-in-ready) with Tri Pointe Homes®, you'll see three stages: Move-In Ready, Under Construction, and Starting Soon. Understanding each stage can help you find a new home that fits your timeline, lifestyle, and design preferences.


## **Move-In Ready Homes**


Move-In Ready homes are complete or expected to be ready for move-in within the next 60 days. The floorplan and all design finishes have already been selected, making this an appealing choice if you’re looking to move sooner or prefer to skip the selection process.


Expert Design Consultants thoughtfully coordinate finishes throughout the home, bringing elements like cabinetry, countertops, and flooring together for a cohesive look.


Depending on the home’s progress, you may be able to see how the finishes work together and get a feel for how one room flows into the next. Picture your dining table in place or decide which corner calls for a comfortable chair and a reading lamp.


If you’re searching for a move-in ready new construction home, your New Home Advisor can confirm the home’s current status and walk you through the next steps toward making it yours.


## **Under Construction Homes**


Under Construction homes are currently being built, with estimated move-in dates more than 60 days away. The floorplan has already been selected, but depending on the home’s progress, there may still be opportunities to personalize some design details.


You can find a layout that fits your lifestyle while still having a chance to add your own touch. Available selections vary by home, so your New Home Advisor can explain which finishes have already been chosen and which options may remain.


Where selections are available, a Design Consultant can help you explore your choices through the[Design Studio](https://www.tripointehomes.com/design-studio) experience and bring them together in a way that reflects your style.


## **Starting Soon Homes**


Starting Soon homes will begin construction soon. The floorplan has already been selected, and these homes generally offer the most opportunities to personalize your design selections.


With more details still to be chosen, you can think about how you want your home to look and feel. Perhaps you’re drawn to warm wood tones, lighter cabinetry or flooring that creates a consistent look across your main living spaces. At the Design Studio, your Design Consultant can help you explore the available options and bring your selections together.


A Starting Soon home can also be a great fit if you have flexibility in your moving timeline and look forward to seeing your new construction home take shape from the beginning.


## **Which New Home Status Fits Your Plans?**


Your moving timeline and how involved you’d like to be in choosing design details can help guide your new home search.


-


**Looking to move sooner or skip the finish selections?**


Move-In Ready homes are complete or expected to be ready within 60 days, with all design finishes already selected.


-


**Want to add a few personal touches?**


An Under Construction home may offer opportunities to choose some finishes, depending on its stage of construction.


-


**Looking forward to choosing more of the details?**


Starting Soon homes generally offer the most opportunities to personalize, with a floorplan already selected and construction beginning soon.


Options and estimated timelines vary by home and community. Your New Home Advisor can help you understand what’s available and which home may fit your plans.


## **Put the Map Filters to Work**


To explore available new homes on the Tri Pointe Homes website, select Find Your Home and the area you’d like to live in. Where available, you can then filter Available Homes by Move-In Ready, Under Construction, and Starting Soon.


Explore one status or compare a few to see which homes catch your eye. Then connect with the community team to learn more about each home’s current status, available selections, and next steps in the homebuying process.


## **Find Your Next Place to Call Home**


Whether you prefer a home with finishes already selected or look forward to adding your own personal touches, there are different ways to begin your next chapter.


[Explore our communities to find a new home that fits the way you want to live.](https://www.tripointehomes.com/find-your-home)
